title: hyperspace-engine — loop.state.json
description: T3.1 (ncf-m3-state-object). Machine-readable position for one multi-session loop run. Mirrors the Graph Machine contract graph_library/contracts/run.py's MachineRun field-for-field where meaning matches (run_id, original_input, input_hash, status, current_node); framework_version plays machine_version's role. status uses the framework PRD's #9.1 LoopStatus set, not run.py's RunStatus — the two enums diverge deliberately (see the T3.1 engineering notes' field-mirroring table). Validated by bin/loop_state.py's hand-rolled minimal draft-07 subset (required/type/enum/properties/items only) — see that file's module docstring for why.

run_id.description: Mirrors MachineRun.run_id. Stored as a string (uuid4 hex/canonical form), not validated as a UUID by the minimal validator.

goal_slug.description: The <goal-slug> in <runs-dir>/<goal-slug>/loop.state.json. Also this run's directory name.

framework_version.description: Plays MachineRun.machine_version's role for the loop (renamed per DECISIONS.md D6 — 'machine_version' names the Graph Machine specifically).

original_input.description: Mirrors MachineRun.original_input. Immutable — the raw submission, set once at init, never rewritten by later saves.

input_hash.description: Mirrors MachineRun.input_hash. sha256 hex digest of original_input, computed once at init.

status.description: PRD #9.1's LoopStatus set, verbatim. Deliberately NOT run.py's RunStatus (see Engineer_Notes field-mirroring table for the divergence).

current_node.description: Mirrors MachineRun.current_node. The stage/node identifier the run is presently in, or null before any node has been entered.

trail.description: History of node transitions, oldest first. The most recent entry has exited_at/outcome null while the run is still in that node.

artifacts.description: T3.2 (ncf-m3-artifact-freeze) fills the freeze/hash behavior; this shape is declared now, not implemented. One entry per artifact frozen at a gate pass.

gates.description: T3.1 design decision (see Engineer_Notes 'gates[] item shape' section — T3.2 inherits this shape). One entry per node whose exit gate has been evaluated.

budget.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters) fills the counting behavior; this shape is declared now. Two counted soft caps plus three round/retry counters. Only measured fields are written (S1, bin/PORT_NOTES.md): a cap nothing observes is not in the file.

fresh_sessions.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters). Soft cap: 1, per task (a provisional number, PRD §6.3). Counted: the SessionStart hook observes `source=startup` and calls `bump --event startup`.

compactions.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters). Soft cap: 1, per task (a provisional number, PRD §6.3). Counted: the SessionStart hook observes `source=compact` and calls `bump --event compact`.

doubled_back_rounds.description: T3.2 (ncf-m3-artifact-freeze). Incremented by check_frozen() (bin/loop_state.py) on every frozen-artifact hash mismatch it discovers — never by an argument telling it a change happened.

doubled_back_events.description: T3.2 (ncf-m3-artifact-freeze). One entry per hash mismatch check_frozen() has ever detected, oldest first — the durable answer to 'which artifact, and when'.

driver.description: T3.6 fills behavior. Who/what was driving at the last approval.

kill.description: T3.5 (ncf-m3-kill-predicate) fills the predicate that sets this. Cause is recorded here; cause never gates (PRD #9.1).

descope_decision_ref.description: T3.5 (ncf-m3-kill-predicate). Set by the `descope` event verb (bin/loop_state.py); a pointer to where the descope decision is recorded, per PRD #9.3 ('the decision is recorded in loop.state.json, not remembered'). Null until a descope decision exists. Presence (not content) is what terminal_route() in loop_terminal.py consults — cause-blind by the same rule as `kill.reason`.

final_route.description: PRD #9.1's LEGITIMATE_TERMINAL set, or null before the run ends. Deliberately NOT run.py's TerminalRoute (see Engineer_Notes field-mirroring table).

escape_rate.description: PRD #6.3: recorded, never thresholded in v1. Written when work moves from finished to confirmed; null until then.
